name: Natural Another One 2nd -Belladonna-
source:
Belladonna is the name of a flower that is both beautiful and extremely poisonous. But it's also the name of the goddess who cuts the fate threads with scissors.

Main character is asked to fulfill a request if he wants to return former lover and get a billion yen. The request is to persuade former lover to abandon all her claims to her dead husband's corporation. Any means are allowed, so he can choose to cultivate love or lust in mansion girls to reach his goal.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]

A "love training adventure game".
translation:
颠茄既是一种美丽而剧毒的花，也是那位用剪刀剪断命运丝线的女神之名。

有人告诉主人公，只要完成一项委托，他就能挽回昔日恋人，并获得十亿日元。委托内容是说服前恋人放弃对亡夫公司的所有权利。为达成目标可以不择手段，他可以选择在宅邸女孩们心中培育爱情或欲望。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]

一款“恋爱调教冒险游戏”。
